ui.steam_launch_mods_warning_title: Warning: Launch via Steam with Mods
ui.steam_launch_mods_warning_body:
You have selected mods to apply, but you are launching the game through Steam.

Mods are applied to files in your configured game path:
{game_path}

However, Steam may launch the game from a different directory (Steam's library folder), which means your mods may not work.

This is especially common on Steam Deck. To ensure mods work correctly, please:
1. Make sure your configured game path matches Steam's installation directory, OR
2. Disable 'Launch via Steam' in Settings to launch directly from the configured path.

Do you want to continue anyway?

tooltips.custom_executable_library: Select a custom executable file for this game. This setting is unique per game.
tooltips.full_install_instructions:
Install game files from scratch for DELTARUNE demo:
  • all needed files are downloaded automatically
  • a new game folder will be selected upon completion.
  • ATTENTION! If you want to run the demo
  • via Steam, you must select the folder STEAM created!

The checkbox is disabled after completion.
tooltips.full_yellow_install_instructions:
Install game files from scratch for UNDERTALE Yellow:
  • all needed files are downloaded automatically
  • a new game folder will be selected upon completion.
  • The archive contains a folder with game files inside.
  • Files will be automatically extracted to the target directory.

The checkbox is disabled after completion.
tooltips.full_spire_install_instructions:
Install game files from scratch for Sugary Spire:
  • all needed files are downloaded automatically
  • a new game folder will be selected upon completion.
  • The archive contains a folder with game files inside.
  • Files will be automatically extracted to the target directory.

The checkbox is disabled after completion.
tooltips.macos_install_unavailable:
Game file installation is not available on macOS.
It's recommended to install the DEMO via Steam.
tooltips.online_counter: This counter shows the number of players playing the game via the launcher.
tooltips.mod_broken: Mod is corrupted or missing files
tooltips.steam: Enable this option to run the game through Steam, so that all your achievements, overlays, etc., work correctly.
tooltips.portproton: Use PortProton instead of Wine to run Windows executables on Linux. PortProton is a compatibility layer that wraps Wine/Proton for easier game compatibility. If PortProton is not in your PATH, you can specify a custom path to the PortProton executable.
tooltips.portproton_disabled_steam: PortProton is not used when launching via Steam. Steam manages its own Wine/Proton compatibility layer.
tooltips.beta_updates: Receive experimental updates and features before they're officially released.
tooltips.skip_patching_warnings:
When enabled, patching will continue automatically without asking
for confirmation when non-critical issues occur
(e.g., xdelta checksum mismatch). Warnings will still be logged.
tooltips.hide_library_filters: Hide filtering options in the library tab to save space.
tooltips.merge_properties: Combines settings (like JSON files) so that changes from different mods are preserved, preventing lost configurations.
tooltips.merge_code: Logically merges game logic code, enabling multiple mods to change the same behaviors without overwriting each other.
tooltips.dont_hide_window_on_launch: Keep the launcher window visible when the game is running.

dialogs.update_permission_error_details:
Failed to replace launcher files due to insufficient permissions or file locks.

Try the following:
1. Close the launcher and run the installer as Administrator.
2. Temporarily disable antivirus/SmartScreen or allow the installer.
3. Install to a different folder (e.g., Desktop) and run from there.
4. Or download the update manually and replace the application.
